description: This file is the main entry point for an Angular application, responsible for bootstrapping the AppModule after configuring production mode if applicable.

methods.name: enableProdMode
methods.description: Enables Angular's production mode which disables assertions and other checks within the framework for optimal performance.

methods.name: platformBrowser
methods.description: Creates a platform for the browser that is used to bootstrap the Angular application.

methods.name: bootstrapModule
methods.description: Bootstraps the specified root application module to launch the Angular application.
